subject.title: feat(memory): provenance-gated memory with dreaming on by default

question: Do memory-area owners approve making dreaming and Active Memory escalation default-on for existing absent-config installations while adopting the new optional memory-host metadata and trigger-recall APIs as a supported plugin contract?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes runtime defaults, starts a managed background workflow for previously omitted settings, and expands a cross-plugin API; these are durable product and compatibility choices rather than mechanical review follow-up.

options.title: Confirm the recorded default-on contract
options.body: Approve the documented upgrade behavior and SDK seam, then require a rebase and final upgrade-focused proof on the merge head.

options.title: Preserve opt-in defaults
options.body: Keep existing omitted-config behavior inactive and expose the new dreaming and escalation paths only through explicit configuration.

options.title: Split the redesign
options.body: Land provenance and safety infrastructure separately while deferring default-on behavior and SDK contract adoption for dedicated owner review.

recommendation.title: Confirm the recorded default-on contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented upgrade behavior and SDK seam, then require a rebase and final upgrade-focused proof on the merge head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied feature history and recorded policy discussion place steipete closest to the memory redesign and its intended defaults.
